notes.title: "Ashes O” becomes "The End Grows - a Tale of Ashes"
notes.notes:
[h1][i]"Ashes O” becomes "[b]The End Grows"[/b][/i][/h1][p]Hello everyone. [/p][p]Today’s update is a bit special: alongside the usual fixes and improvements, it officially marks the [b]name change of the project[/b].[/p][h3]🔄 Why this change?[/h3][p]The game was originally developed under the name [b]Ashes O[/b], as a way to connect it with my first game [i]Ashes – Exponential RPG[/i] on iOS and Android, which takes place in the same universe. The “O” also referred to the circular open world you explore.[/p][p]However, with time this name showed its limits:[/p][list][*][p]It created [b]confusion with the MMO [i]Ashes of Creation[/i][/b], making my game harder to find.[/p][/*][*][p]The title lacked [b]clarity and elegance[/b]. The “O” in particular was abrupt and obscure, not really speaking to players.[/p][/*][*][p]It didn’t reflect the [b]narrative heart of the game[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]That’s why I decided to change the name to [b]The End Grows[/b].[/p][h3]🌍 Why [i]The End Grows[/i]?[/h3][p]This new name captures much better the spirit of the game:[/p][list][*][p]The end of the world that progresses, as seen in the [b]five last minutes of the world repeating in a loop[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]final revelation of the story[/b], foreshadowed since the very beginning.[/p][/*][*][p]A darker and more evocative atmosphere, aligned with the narrative.[/p][/*][/list][p]To keep the connection with the [i]Ashes[/i] universe, the subtitle will remain in the store description:
👉 [i]a tales of Ashes[/i][/p][h3]📢 Transparency with players[/h3][list][*][p]The Steam page will clearly mention that the game was previously called [i]Ashes O[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]My Discord community has already been informed and understands this choice.[/p][/*][*][p]A new marketing campaign will soon launch, with a larger budget, and will openly explain this name change.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎮 The game itself[/h3][p]Nothing in the [b]gameplay[/b] or the [b]artistic direction[/b] has changed. The project continues exactly in the same direction as from the very beginning — only the title is evolving.[/p][p]This change is simply a correction of an initial mistake (both in terms of meaning and marketing) and will give the game a better chance to be discovered by more players.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you very much for your support since the early days of [i]Ashes O[/i].
I’ll keep doing everything I can to make sure this transition is clear and transparent for everyone.[/p][p]👉 [i]Ashes O[/i] is now [b]The End Grows[/b]. The journey continues![/p]

notes.title: Steam Cloud Save is now functional!
notes.notes:
🔧 The Steam Cloud Save feature is now fully functional! 🌐

This feature allows your game saves to sync automatically across all devices connected to Steam. ✉️ You can now continue your progress anywhere, knowing your data is secure and up to date. 🛡️

⚠️ Important:
To avoid any data loss or conflicts, we recommend the following steps:

✉️ First, log in on the device that contains your most recent or most important save file. 💾

ℹ️ Make sure the save file is fully synced to the cloud before switching to another device. 🔗
